about: English call scenarios for the live-voice session test when no language pack is installed (the Turkish set the bench was measured on lives in the pack, tr/tests/daemon/voice_bench/scenarios.json). Same ids, kinds and pauses. Synthetic text only. Each scenario is one caller turn (or none) built from segments; pause_ms is the silence after a segment. A pause inside one turn is a thinking pause the call must not end the turn on; a segment the caller trails off on ends with a comma, which is how an English transcript says it is unfinished. 'reference' is what a perfect recogniser writes.
